rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both letters respond to defense-related changed circumstances by distinguishing an urgent interim legislative measure from a more comprehensive program that Congress lacks time to complete immediately. Each then argues that the interim step can be enacted without prejudicing later comprehensive consideration and closes by requesting prompt favorable committee action. C16 shares the changed-circumstances-and-defense rationale but not this distinctive interim/full-review structure. C07 shares the committee-action request but little else beyond routine congressional correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I realize that there is insufficient time for the Congress to make a full investigation of these problems and consider a new rent control law during the present session.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I appreciate that the development of a comprehensive revenue program adequate for our present needs will require careful Congressional consideration... such a comprehensive tax program could not be completed for some time.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish that a comprehensive legislative response requires more time and congressional study.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The extension of the automatic decontrol date to March 31, 1951, will permit the Eighty-second Congress to give full consideration... and make whatever changes in the law may be necessary.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I recommend that, as an interim revenue measure, action should be taken immediately... This could be done without interfering in any way with the development of a more comprehensive revenue program as soon as practicable.
shared_material.explanation: Both propose an immediate interim measure expressly designed to preserve later comprehensive legislation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I will appreciate it if you will take this matter up with your committee with a view to obtaining favorable action upon such an extension.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I earnestly hope that they will be favorably acted upon by the Congress at an early date.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by seeking prompt favorable congressional action on the interim proposal.
